steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Video games are an interactive media form where players actively participate in constructing the narrative and experience, unlike passive media forms. | Key Fact: Game genres: action, RPG, FPS, sports, puzzle, simulation, adventure, strategy, horror, MMO. Genres set player expectations and guide marketing. | Key Fact: Platforms: console (PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo), PC, mobile, and cloud gaming. Each platform has different conventions, audiences, and business models. | Key Fact: Industry structure: AAA (major studio) games have budgets of $100m+; indie games are made by small teams with limited budgets. The industry generates more revenue than film and music combined.
